name: Shiinamachi
tagline: Shinjuku in 15 minutes and Shibuya in 20 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 30.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 30.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 29.6 m to 35.1 m, a difference of 5.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: フードショップ埼玉屋

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 恭和会橋本病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 恭和会恭和記念病院, about 5 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Ikebukuro Line.
congestion: Seibu Ikebukuro Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 椎名町→池袋, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kanamecho is ahead on the number of lines, but Shiinamachi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shiinamachi. Kanamecho also has the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, which Shiinamachi does not. With more lines, Kanamecho is the better connected of the two. To Toranomon, for instance, Kanamecho is 5 minutes quicker. On how easy the shopping is, though, Shiinamachi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Shiinamachi in a straight line. Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki has the Toei Oedo Line, a different set from Shiinamachi. To Roppongi, for instance, Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki is 8 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 less at Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
山手通り (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
